questions_and_answers.question_text: Jīntian wǒ jièdào yìběn hǎo xiǎoshuō.

answers.answer_text: Today I borrowed a good novel (from someone).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shénme xiǎoshuō, ràng ni zènme gāoxìng?

answers.answer_text: What novel is it that makes you so happy?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèiběn xiǎoshuō xiěde shi dàlùde qíngkuàng.

answers.answer_text: This novel is about the situation on the mainland.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Guānyú dàlùde? Jiè gěi wo kànkan xíng bu xíng?

answers.answer_text: About the mainland? How about lending it to me to read?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiàge xuéqī nǐ xiǎng yánjiū shénme?

answers.answer_text: What are you going to do research on next semester?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Hái shi lǎo wèntí: Zhōngguóde zhèngzhì qíngkuàng.

answers.answer_text: It's still the same old topic: the political situation in China.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zuótian Xiǎo Míng gěi ta nǚpéngyou xiě xìn, xiěde hǎo cháng!

answers.answer_text: Yesterday Xiǎo Míng wrote a letter to his girl friend, and it was really long!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Niánqīng rén zǒng shi niánqīng rén. Wǒ niánqīngde shíhou yě shi zhèiyàng, nǐ wàng le?

answers.answer_text: Young people are always young people. When I was young I was like that too, have you forgotten?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shǔjiàde shíhou, nǐ xiǎng dào nǎr qu wánrwanr?

answers.answer_text: Where do you want to go over summer vacation?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Wǒ xiǎng dào Yàzhōu jǐge guójiā qu kànkan.

answers.answer_text: I'd like to go visit a few countries in Asia.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zěnme, nǐ xiǎng yánjiū Yàzhōude wénhuà chuántǒng?

answers.answer_text: Oh? Do you want to do research on Asia's cultural tradition?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bù néng shuō yánjiū. Wǒ zhǐ shi xiǎng qù kànkan nàlide shèhuì qíngkuàng.

answers.answer_text: It can't be called research. I just want to go have a look at the social situation there.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Lǎo Wáng, wǒ jīntian gǎnjué hěn bù shūfu.

answers.answer_text: Lǎo Wáng, I feel awful today.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Kuài zuòxia, wǒ qù gěi ni dào bēi chá lai.

answers.answer_text: Sit down and I'll go pour you a cup of tea.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ qùde nèige dìfang zhèngzhì, jīngjì fāngmiànde qíngxing zěnmeyàng?

answers.answer_text: What was the political and economic situation like where you went?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Jǐjù huà shuōbuqīngchu, yǒu shíjiān wǒ zài gēn ni mànmanr shuō ba.

answers.answer_text: I can't explain it clearly in just a few sentences; when I have time I'll tell you all about it.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Yánjiū Zhōngguo xiànzàide wèntí yídìng děi dǒngde Zhōngguo lìshǐ.

answers.answer_text: To study the problems of China now, you have to understand Chinese history.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ shuōde zhèiyìdiǎn hěn yàojǐn, wǒ kǎolǜ kǎolǜ.

answers.answer_text: This point of yours is very important; I'll think it over.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ zài Zhōngguo zhù liǎngnián, yídìng huì xuéhǎo Zhōngwénde.

answers.answer_text: If you live in China for two years, you're sure to learn Chinese very well.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, yìfāngmiàn kěyi xuéhǎo Zhōngwén, yìfāngmiàn yě kěyi duō zhīdao yìdiǎnr Zhōngguóde shìqing.

answers.answer_text: Yes, on the one hand I can learn Chinese well, and on the other hand I can find out more things about China.

questions_and_answers.question_text: yìbiān(r)...yìbiān(r)

answers.answer_text: doing...while doing...

questions_and_answers.question_text: yímiàn(r)...yímiàn(r)...

answers.answer_text: doing...while doing...
